justification: The witness requires b_{1,1,2}=1, but these are Lie-bracket structure constants, so [e_1,e_1]=0 forces b_{1,1,2}=0. Moreover, the [source formula](https://arxiv.org/html/1903.05032v4#S4.SS3) specifies a_i=Σb_{ijk}a_k t_j as a solution; it does not equate α_i with a function. Choosing a_i=0 does not refute that solution claim.
